rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This Devici MCP server provides complete API integration with the Devici threat modeling platform, enabling AI assistants to manage security workflows through natural language interactions. Built by Geoff Whittington using FastMCP and httpx, it offers tools for user and team management, collection and threat model creation, component analysis, threat identification, mitigation planning, and dashboard reporting across the entire threat modeling lifecycle. The implementation supports OAuth2 authentication and covers all major Devici API endpoints, making it valuable for security teams who want to automate threat modeling processes, generate security reports, and manage enterprise security assessments through conversational interfaces rather than manual platform navigation.
